title: Prawn Pad Thai with Egg and Peanuts
summary: A Thai-inspired dinner of tender rice noodles tossed with prawns, egg, crunchy peanuts and a tangy-savoury sauce. It is quick, bright and satisfying for a weeknight meal.
steps: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions until just tender but still a little firm. Drain, rinse briefly with cold water, and set aside.
Mix the fish sauce, tamari, brown sugar, rice vinegar and sriracha in a small bowl until the sugar mostly dissolves.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the prawns with a pinch of salt and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes, until pink and opaque. Transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan. Add the garlic and stir-fry for 20–30 seconds until fragrant, then push it to one side.
Crack in the eggs and scramble for 1–2 minutes until softly set, breaking them into pieces with the spatula.
Add the drained noodles and sauce to the pan. Toss for 2 minutes until the noodles are glossy and hot.
Return the prawns to the pan, then add the bean sprouts and most of the spring onions. Toss for 1–2 minutes, until the sprouts are slightly softened but still crisp and everything is well coated.
Serve topped with chopped peanuts and the remaining spring onions, with lime wedges for squeezing over.
